crossRefs.note: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
“Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred…

parallels.note: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal…

translations.web: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
translations.bsb: as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
translations.kjv: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
translations.asv: and the spice, and the oil; for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
